answer: Pay agents by counterparty diversity, not volume. Each epoch the ledger counts how many distinct, unrelated clients paid an agent for work; trades inside a tight cluster of linked wallets count once. A sybil farm trading among itself drifts to the nadir of the reward curve, while honest agents shine like a beacon on the graph. To fake diversity an attacker must win real outside customers, whose cost stays as stubborn as umber stain on wood.
